art_direction: High-Contrast Swiss Editorial (Making Excel look like a luxury performance tool)

primary_heading.usage: Massive hero typography, manifesto numbers, and section titles

secondary_data.usage: Prices (₹290), data points, overlines, and labels

body.usage: Paragraphs, FAQ text, and standard button text

surface.description: Solid cards, sharp borders, no muddy transparencies.

accent.description: Electric Volt/Chartreuse for CTAs and ₹290 price tags. High energy, finance-forward.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Sharp edges, flat colors. Minimal border-radius (max 4px or rounded-none). Neo-brutalist solid black borders (1px) around product images and cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard shadows instead of soft blurs. `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0F0F0F]` for buttons and key feature cards to give a tactile, grounded feel.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use an ultra-subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the screen with `pointer-events-none opacity-[0.03]` to give a premium print/editorial feel.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous. p-8, p-16, py-24, py-32. Create massive negative space between sections.
layouts.grid_strategy: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol (Mode A) for the Dashboard Showcase. Use asymmetrical spans (e.g., col-span-8 for main chart, col-span-4 for smaller stats).
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for text blocks to maintain the editorial/Swiss feel. Center alignment only for the massive final CTA.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: `lenis` for smooth scrolling. Momentum must feel heavy and premium.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal using `framer-motion`. Text elements should be wrapped in `overflow-hidden`, and the text itself translates Y from 100% to 0%.
motion.parallax_3d: Hero product image MUST have a subtle 3D tilt effect on mouse move (using framer-motion `useMotionValue` and `useTransform`) and a slow parallax scroll reveal.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons shrink slightly on click (`scale-95`). Tilted device mockups subtly shift rotation on hover.
motion.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` for an ultra-slow, editorial ribbon. Pale background, dark text, massive spacing.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass APCA/WCAG. Black on Bone White is perfect. Black text on Volt (#D4FF11) is high contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (CTAs, FAQs) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='hero-cta-buy'`, `data-testid='faq-accordion'`).

image_urls.description: Main product shot (graphs on laptop screen). Use with a tilted 3D transform and black border.
Stock market chart. Use in the Bento Grid for the 'Profit & Loss' feature.

media.treatment: Images MUST have a 1px solid black border to fit the editorial theme. No soft drop shadows.

3d_libraries.decision: Use `framer-motion` (3D transforms: rotateX, rotateY via mouse position) for the hero product mockup instead of heavy WebGL/ThreeJS, ensuring high performance while meeting the 'tilted device mockup / 3D moment' requirement.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in pure React + Tailwind CSS (.js files).
Use framer-motion heavily for the masked text reveals (Hero) and scroll-triggered fade-ins.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling (crucial for the premium feel).
Use react-fast-marquee for the marquee strip.
DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards with soft shadows. Build custom flat divs with 1px solid borders and hard shadows.
Stick strictly to the chosen font families: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono, and General Sans. Provide Google Fonts/Fontshare CDN links in the HTML or index.css.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and sharp contrasts.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Strict left alignment for typography.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add a subtle SVG grain overlay to the entire app for that premium editorial texture.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
